integrity: A complete uniform finite-metric proof is included. The standalone finite tests are reproducibility cross-checks, not an independent mathematical proof or an exhaustive search for arbitrary k. Literature priority remains subject to independently checking unindexed or inaccessible publications.
scientific_limitations: Only circular geodesic distances restricted to the four-point set and to a (4k+2)-point set; no claim for Euclidean chord distance or odd target cardinality; no classification of all optimal correspondences.
title: Exact Gromov–Hausdorff distances from the geodesic square to regular \(4k+2\)-gons
